Both Assistant A and Assistant B provided accurate and detailed explanations of the differences between exothermic and endothermic reactions, as well as real-world examples. However, when answering the second question about a process involving both reactions, Assistant B provided a more comprehensive response. Assistant B not only explained photosynthesis as an example but also mentioned other examples such as respiration, phase changes, and cooking food. This additional information makes Assistant B's response more informative and helpful. Therefore, I choose Assistant B as the better assistant in this case.
